name: linux-email-setup
title: Email Setup
description: Mail client installation, profiles, Microsoft 365 reachability and DNS

checks.title: Installed mail clients
command: for c in thunderbird evolution kmail geary mutt; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$c: $(command -v $c)"; done

checks.title: TCP reachability of Microsoft 365 endpoints
command: for t in outlook.office365.com:443 smtp.office365.com:587 login.microsoftonline.com:443 autodiscover-s.outlook.com:443; do
if nc -z -w 4 "$h" "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "$h:$p reachable"; else echo "$h:$p UNREACHABLE"; fi
if timeout 4 sh -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/$h/$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo "$h:$p reachable"; else echo "$h:$p UNREACHABLE"; fi

checks.title: DNS resolver configuration
command: resolvectl status 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'DNS Servers|DNS Domain' | head -10 || cat /etc/resolv.conf
